paragraphs: The elder son of Shimon the Righteous, [Menachot 109b](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.109b.12-16); see the entry Shimon the Righteous.

notes.text: The linked verse names Shimi son of Gera. The later Shimi appears in the linked Menachot story as Chonyo’s brother.
Rabbi Meir’s version has Shimi jealous of Chonyo. Rabbi Yehudah’s has Chonyo jealous of Shimi. Both agree that Shimi was two and a half years older.

Hyman’s printed notice (vol. III, p. 1228) gives II Samuel 16:5. The supplied transcription has the malformed locator פ״טו-יה. The verse names the biblical Shimi son of Gera. In Menachot 109b, both accounts call the other Shimi two and a half years older than Chonyo, while they differ on who was jealous of whom.
